stages.create: Keep tidewatch:level:0-south-door-0 under native-structure / existing scene interaction owner. Add references only; no new actor, inventory or media registry entry is inferred.
stages.save: Save the native document unchanged, plus a separately versioned sidecar pinning document ID/revision, object pointer, representation, pack version and rights evidence. Save is an author checkpoint, not a live action.
stages.prepare: Resolve the exact source pointer, calibration and dependency closure; validate rights and audience policy. Missing calibration permits artwork preview only. An NPC without a resolved actor owner stays visibly unbound.
stages.play: Submit an operation ID, expected owner version and current scene revision to the existing authoritative owner; show pending until its accepted/rejected receipt. Query ambiguous operations before retry; local preview cannot grant permission.
stages.export: Resolve the requested audience and export capability separately. Flattening, source-byte redistribution and campaign delivery are different actions. GM-only handout is excluded from player output including metadata and dependency lists.
stages.recovery: Reopen the native checkpoint and pinned references. Check owner operation status before replay; keep unresolved markers for missing bytes/version/calibration. Relink by reviewed identity and rights, never filename alone.
